title: MemoBrain Notes Config Profile
description: Configuration distributed by the cloud service (§2.6.6). A profile sets any subset of these keys; keys listed in locked_keys cannot be overridden by the user.

features.description: Feature flags: a false value hides the function in the client. A flag a profile does not set takes its default. Unknown flags are accepted and ignored by clients that do not know them.

audio_recorder.description: Audio recorder in the editor. Reserved: no client offers the function yet, so the flag has no visible effect.

web_viewer.description: Built-in web page viewer. Reserved: no client offers the function yet, so the flag has no visible effect.

chat.description: Chat bar of the workbench (a disabled placeholder until the ACP integration exists, ADR-0026).

ai.description: Reserved: AI writing assistant of the editor (ADR-0050). Implemented but inactive: it also needs a build that enables it, so a profile alone cannot switch it on in a released build.

collab.description: Reserved: real-time collaboration in the editor (ADR-0050). Implemented but off: it also needs a build that enables it and a registered provider, and none exists.

web_workbench.description: Opening vaults in the browser (vault workbench of the Web UI, ADR-0029). The desktop ignores it.

drawings.description: Excalidraw drawings: creating, opening and embedding .excalidraw files. Off also disables every drawing_* flag.

presentations.description: Marp presentations (.marp): creating them, the SlideShow panel, full-screen presenting and the HTML, PDF and PPTX exports (ADR-0047, ADR-0048).

sharing.description: Sharing a vault with users and groups, and the received shares: settings section, status bar and file menu of the workbench; Sharing page, mounts and invitations of the console.

drawing_latex.description: LaTeX formulas in drawings (only while drawings is on).

drawing_mermaid.description: Mermaid diagrams converted to drawings (only while drawings is on).

drawing_auto_export.description: Automatic SVG/PNG export of drawings on save (only while drawings is on).

drawing_actions.description: Scene actions of the drawing tools panel (only while drawings is on).

envelope_v2.description: Write private-vault key envelopes in format v2, bound to the vault and kind (ADR-0034); an unlock upgrades a v1 envelope to v2. On by default since 1.3.0: desktop 1.2.4 and earlier cannot open a v2 envelope, so update every desktop before the cloud or set false until then. Turning it off stops new upgrades only: a client that has seen a v2 envelope of a kind never writes v1 again.

path_v2.description: Write the encrypted path tokens of private vaults in format v2 (enc2), bound to the file id, and migrate the remaining enc1 tokens in the background while a vault is unlocked (ADR-0042). On by default since 1.3.0: desktop 1.2.4 and earlier cannot read enc2 paths, so update every desktop before the cloud or set false until then. Turning it off stops the migration only: a vault already seen in enc2 keeps enc2, and a fully migrated vault refuses enc1.

statusBar.description: Compact status bar under the editor area with words, characters, selection, line:column and mode of the active editor (ADR-0035). Off when not set.

hotkeys.description: Default hotkeys: command id to combination.

interval_seconds.description: Polling interval of the sync when push notifications are not available.

max_file_size_bytes.description: Files larger than this are not synchronized (the client reports them).

library_share_id.description: Share mounted read-only as the template library of the group

redirect_mode.description: Desktop sign-in redirect (D-08): loopback with fallback to the custom scheme (auto), loopback only, or custom scheme only.

vault_lock_minutes.description: Idle minutes after which an unlocked private vault forgets its key on the device (0 = never)
